# Spark Agent

Spark Agent is a local-first AI Agent workbench for software development, debugging, code review, multi-agent teamwork, runtime governance, provider and MCP configuration, and cinematic infinite-canvas creation.

## Key pages
- Homepage: /
- Features: /features
- Infinite Canvas: /canvas
- Architecture: /architecture
- Download: /download
- Docs: /docs
- Roadmap: /roadmap
- Open source: /open-source
- Contact: /contact
- GitHub: https://github.com/alexanderizh/spark-agent

## Core capabilities
- Local-first Electron desktop workbench with React renderer, typed IPC, SQLite storage, and system credential storage
- Coding loop with side chat, terminal, Git Review, HunkDiff, worktree isolation, checkpoints, debug mode, and browser automation
- Team Agent mode where a Host Agent dispatches tasks to member agents with independent models, tools, Skills, MCP, budgets, and context
- Dual execution engines: Claude Agent SDK and Codex CLI / OpenAI paths
- Provider, MCP, Skill, permissions, usage ledger, rules, hooks, and audit events for runtime governance
- Infinite canvas for scripts, storyboards, prompts, assets, AI generation tasks, lineage, and film production planning
- Media runtime for image, video, audio, and OpenAI-compatible provider adapters, depending on configured provider manifests
